payload.reason: The evidence discusses various NLG tasks and evaluation metrics used in the field, including readability, grammaticality, and automatic evaluation measures.

claims.text: NLG evaluation considers readability and grammaticality as important properties of texts.
Automatic evaluation measures, such as BLEU, are commonly used in NLG research.
Word-based metrics (WBMs) and grammar-based metrics (GBMs) are two types of evaluation metrics used in NLG.
The paper investigates end-to-end, data-driven NLG methods and compares different approaches.
The study emphasizes the need for novel evaluation metrics that are system- and data-independent.
